title: Mixed Berry Chia Yogurt Cups
steps: On Sunday, stir the chia seeds, ground flaxseed, and cinnamon into the yogurt.
Divide the yogurt between four jars and chill at least 2 hours, so the chia softens and thickens it.
Hull and halve the strawberries; leave the other berries whole.
Top each jar with the berries just before eating, not at assembly — use what you have on hand; the proportions between them do not matter.
storageNotes: Make the yogurt base Sunday and refrigerate it up to 3 days. Keep the berries separate and add them per jar as you eat: these are already near the end of their life, and raspberries and blackberries weep into yogurt within a day. The chia keeps absorbing liquid, so the base thickens each day; loosen with a spoonful of milk or water if it gets too stiff.
goldenRuleCallouts: Plain yogurt only — sweetened tubs are the added-sugar trap in a snack like this.
Built around the four berries already in the house, assembled Sunday because they will not last to Saturday.
Berries, chia, and flax cover fiber and omega-3s without a packet of anything.
